designNarrative: The supervisor's existing Tick() gains one new last step: classify the current ledger replay into busy/idle/waiting (a pure fold over map[string]*OrderState, no I/O), then announce it only if it differs from the last state reported, via the Supervisor's existing s.say output mechanism. All new logic lives in a single new file (idle.go) matching the package's existing one-concern-per-file convention, with a zero-value tickBusy sentinel on a new lastReported field giving print-once-per-entry semantics for free. Behaviour change: yes — the supervisor now prints two new console lines it previously never printed.
performanceSurface: reportTickState adds a 4th independent s.Orders() ledger fold per Tick(), consistent with existing precedent (settleEnded/advanceFinishLine/startWork each already do their own); local, append-only file read, not flagged as a regression.
testDesignReview: TestAFreshSupervisorWithNoOrdersReportsIdle — YES: asserts exact idle string once; fails if announce doesn't fire or branch name is wrong.
TestIdlePrintsOnceAcrossConsecutiveTicks — YES: fails if the once-per-entry guard regresses to printing every tick.
TestAGateHaltCountsAsWaiting — YES: fails if waitingPhases drops PhaseWaiting from the count.
TestAParkedOrderCountsAsWaiting — YES: fails if PhaseParked stops counting as waiting.
TestASecondWaitingOrderReprintsWithTheIncrementedCount — YES: fails if count changes don't force a reprint.
TestLeavingWaitingThenReturningToIdleReprints — YES: fails if leaving a state wrongly reprints, or re-entering idle stays silent.
TestARetryingOrderPrintsNothing — YES, negative test: fails if a retrying order is misclassified as idle or waiting.
TestOnceAppliesTheOncePerEntryRuleToItsSinglePass — YES: fails if Once() reprints the idle line on an unchanged second pass.
None of the diff's tests are vacuous, self-fulfilling, or unreached; all assert on the actual printed output buffer rather than a mock's own configured return.
